prompt: Ali scored 72 in a maths test (mean 60, standard deviation 8) and 68 in a physics test (mean 55, standard deviation 5). In which test did he perform better relative to the class?
markscheme:
$z_{\text{maths}}=\dfrac{72-60}{8}=1.5$, $z_{\text{physics}}=\dfrac{68-55}{5}=2.6$ **(M1)**

Physics: his score is more standard deviations above the mean **(A1)**

concept: Finding unknown mean and standard deviation
